final_decision.rationale: JPEG is certain in presence (block_boundary 3.9/7.4 >> 1.1, 0% FP) and sev4 best matches the blockiness magnitude. Blur is certain in presence but the subtype discriminating signals are corrupted by JPEG: glass_score is an FP (gaussian sim also 1.35), motion is excluded (anisotropy < 1.7; PSNR 21.16), gaussian/lens are MTF-indistinguishable -> gaussian (SKILL default) with lens alternative. Blur sev4 chosen because kernel-shape metrics match the g4 sim best and PSNR ties g3 (gap 0.02 dB -> g3 alternative). No noise (sigma<2, §B FP documented) and no representable global step (all candidates worsen PSNR). Full deterministic pipeline PSNR 26.77 dB / CI 7/10, replicated on pair1 (27.52 dB / CI 7/10) and pair2 (26.62 dB / CI 6/10); <30 dB and <40 dB -> UNCERTAIN, not LIKELY; CI structure is GOOD so not POOR
